network_operator: Transmission connection in SP Transmission area (Hunterston is a major 400 kV node); specific connection agreement for the data centre not identified
nearby_substation: Hunterston 400 kV substation (adjacent to former Hunterston A/B nuclear stations; landing point for HVDC and offshore wind links)
evidence_basis: Developer website states a 'high-voltage transmission level connection' with no MW figure. The adjacent Revera BESS holds transmission entry capacity on NESO's TEC register with a 400 kV substation under construction. No NESO/TEC entry has been verified for the data centre itself.
overlaps_other_project: Hunterston BESS (Revera Energy, 400 MW/800 MWh, consented 2022, FID June 2026); Highview Power 2.5 GWh liquid-air storage planned at Hunterston PARC — all competing for / using the same Hunterston grid node
notes: Hunterston's status as a major grid node (former nuclear connection capacity) is the developers' stated rationale for the location. The data centre's own connection route — new TEC, sharing the BESS connection, or private wire — is not disclosed.
